purpose: hotfix for 1.5.7 conversation-sync panel replaying stale persisted job errors (release-night incident)

incident.what: User opened the app (1.5.7) before ever using conversation sync and saw a red 'Codex · 失败: 对话同步失败，请重试。' banner
incident.rootCause: A release-night smoke test without full profile isolation POSTed /api/session-sync/upload against the real ~/.tokentracker-personal directory; the doomed test job (sessionId 'x') was persisted to session-sync/job.json, and the panel replayed the last finished job's errors on every mount
incident.impact: cosmetic only — no network transfer, no registry/upload record, no statistics touched; the polluted directory was removed from the user's machine
incident.fix: panel surfaces job results only for jobs started in the current view instance (ownJobIds); SESSION_SYNC_LOCAL_MISSING localized; regression test added

verification.dashboard: 152 files / 1334 tests (incl. new stale-job regression), tsc, production build, all validators green
verification.remote: latest=personal-v1.5.8; asset digests match; SHA256SUMS byte-identical; both installers ranged 206 first-1MiB match
